assessment_reason: IMC conditions requiring IFR with light icing en route and gusty crosswind at departure — manageable but demanding.
synoptic: An active frontal zone across the Channel brings widespread low cloud, light precipitation, and moderate winds. Freezing levels around 4500-5000ft with light rime icing in the frontal cloud band.
specific_concerns: Channel crossing in IMC with light icing layer between 4500-7000ft. Departure crosswind at EGTK gusty to 28kt. Conditions improve toward Paris with higher ceilings.
watch_items: Monitor EGTK wind gusts — if sustained above 30kt, may exceed crosswind limits. Watch for freezing level drop which could extend icing layer lower.
